candidates.prompt: Create one 1024x1024 seamless repeatable square GAME GROUND BASE-COLOR / DIFFUSE ALBEDO TEXTURE. The image is a perfectly flat orthographic top-down surface with no perspective, no camera tilt, no horizon, no rendered material ball, no illustration scene and no objects. The pattern must repeat continuously in BOTH directions: matching block courses, grout lines and scale at opposite borders, without an outer frame or wide edge strips. The entire square is filled by the paving surface. Flat uniformly diffuse material-color presentation: NO baked sun direction, specular reflections, illumination gradient, cast shadows, ambient occlusion shadows, bevel highlights, glow or vignette. Surface detail should be fine and restrained, not a photographic macro shot. This is for a bright, cheerful Chinese temple-fair miniature market street at dusk, with warm cream wooden shops, vermilion lanterns and orange-pink sky; the atmosphere lighting will be applied in the engine later. Keep the texture itself clean, middle-to-light in value, comfortably warm and low-contrast. Gentle authentic wear and minute pores, with small material-color variations. No soot, black oil, muddy puddles, large cracks, moss takeover, purple cyberpunk color, neon reflections, pure-white grid, blood or fresh red liquid. No people, faces, cats, lettering, symbols, painted decoration, central medallion, road markings, buildings, plants, leaves, advertising or border. Produce ONE independent material tile, not a contact sheet. MATERIAL 1: warmly colored small fired-clay rectangular paving bricks, about 2:1 aspect ratio, a calm repeating half-offset running-bond pattern. Eight evenly spaced horizontal courses, four whole-brick lengths across the repeat, an EVEN number of courses so both borders match. Pale terracotta / apricot ochre material around #c8956a, with restrained warm tan #d5ae85 and sandy peach #d4aa80 variations; not saturated orange-red. Narrow shallow sandy-brown joints only a little darker than the brick faces, approximately 1% of brick length, not thick dark outlines. Bricks mostly intact and flat, slightly softened worn edges with fine pores and a few tiny chips; no protruding relief, no grime blobs. At the image borders continue the exact running-bond rhythm and joint widths; do not add any frame.

candidates.prompt: Edit this paving texture to fix the repeating brick-course layout while preserving its warm pale terracotta material color, fine pores and restrained old wear. Output ONE square orthographic flat albedo texture, not a montage. The square must contain EXACTLY EIGHT complete horizontal brick courses in half-offset running bond and EXACTLY FOUR brick lengths across. Brick length is about twice brick height. Top and bottom edges should both fall at the MIDLINE of a narrow horizontal sandy-brown joint, so joining them makes one ordinary-width joint and exactly eight even courses. The last course must be the opposite half-offset phase to the first; there must be no shortened ninth course or tall merged course at the wrap. Left and right edges must continue every row at exactly the same phase, spacing, material tone and normal narrow joint width; any cut brick across those edges must join as one ordinary whole brick when directly repeated. Uniform width and height throughout, no border frame. Match low-contrast warm peach/ochre brick around #c8956a with tiny natural muted tan variations, a clean bright temple-fair market material. Grout remains subdued sandy brown, not white or black. Flat diffuse BASE COLOR only, no perspective, no baked directional light, bevel highlighting, shadow, shine or global color gradient. No central object, lettering, motifs, neon, stains or rubble. Preserve the full square high-resolution texture and deliver no annotations.

candidates.prompt: Repair the CENTRAL CROSS seam in this exact cyclic-offset brick texture, keeping the existing warm pale terracotta albedo style and fine pores. The input is one full-size paving tile shifted by half its width and height, so former outer-wrap defects are now a straight vertical line and a straight horizontal line crossing in the middle. At the horizontal middle, two brick bands meet without a natural joint and the brick endpoints do not form a clean ordinary alternating running bond. Repair that area into one continuous orderly staggered brick-paving pattern with normal-height courses and normal narrow sandy-brown joints. At the vertical middle reconnect any cut bricks into ordinary whole brick faces; no unexplained vertical scar. Keep the exterior frame area and outermost edges of this OFFSET input matched to their current adjacent texture structure: those edges already come from adjacent original pixels. Do not add border strips, fill patches, light streaks, long shadows, bright grout, uniform blur or a different colored central strip. The repaired square must be directly seamless when repeated in both axes, even if the original count of rows has to change slightly. Light-to-middle warm ochre / muted apricot clay, flat top-down diffuse BASE COLOR only, no sculpted bevels or directional lighting. No text, motifs, decorative borders, objects, grime stains, oil, neon or vignette. Output ONE square high-resolution material, not a montage.
